texts.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God's Destructor - Makyura" once per turn.
texts.name: The Sun God's Destructor - Makyura
texts.str3: Activate by applying the effect of {CARD}.
